content.text: Latency spike at 07:52 correlates directly with pricing.io-internal.svc slow calls (1500ms, nearly all requests). No changes deployed. This is an internal dependency (io-pricing, owned by checkout-platform).

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's latency jump at 07:52 coincides with pricing.io-internal.svc (io-pricing) taking 1500ms per call for basket-total, hitting all or nearly all requests each minute thereafter. No deployment or config change occurred on io-shop in the prior 24h, and io-pricing is an internal dependency owned by the same organisation (checkout-platform), so the fault arrived through that dependency rather than originating in io-shop.
